name: Srivari Spices & Foods Ltd.
summary: Srivari Spices & Foods Ltd. is an Indian Fast-Moving Consumer Goods (FMCG) company headquartered in Hyderabad, primarily engaged in the manufacturing and marketing of spices and flour within the consumer staples sector. The company offers a diverse range of products under the "Srivari" brand, including pure spices such as red chili, turmeric, and coriander, alongside various blended spices like Madras Sambar Masala, Chicken Masala, Garam Masala, Mutton Masala, Pav Bhaji Masala, and Sabzi Masala. Additionally, it produces Sharbati and regular whole wheat flour. Srivari Spices & Foods Ltd. has expanded its offerings to include oils and groceries, with plans for upcoming pure safflower and groundnut oil products. The company sources its raw materials, including wheat and spices, directly from farmers across India, utilizing processes like cold-grinding for spices to preserve quality. The company primarily targets the Indian retail market, with a strong presence in the southern regions, particularly Telangana and Andhra Pradesh. It distributes its products through a network of over 15,000 retail outlets for atta and more than 3,000 outlets for spices and masalas in these states. Srivari Spices & Foods Ltd. also employs a Direct-to-Consumer (D2C) model for its wheat flour, delivering to customers' doorsteps in Hyderabad and surrounding areas. While its current focus is on the Telangana and Andhra Pradesh markets, the company is also exploring export opportunities.
